stories.title: US power prices fall with utility-scale solar, rise with rooftop
stories.description: MIT researchers say there is no link between renewable portfolio standards or utility-scale wind and solar and higher US residential power prices, but rooftop solar correlates with higher rates and distribution costs.

stories.title: EcoFlow launches 5-30 kWh residential storage system
stories.description: The three-model range combines battery backup, solar charging and a new home panel, Three models offer 5–30 kWh of storage, and with immediate availability. It’s a smaller starting option versus EcoFlow’s Delta Pro Ultra systems.

stories.title: The Download: open model trade-offs and geothermal power’s promise
stories.description: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Open models have real benefits. Do they outweigh the risks?

stories.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
stories.description: The problem with giving everyone in a company access to AI tools is that people will use them in unexpected ways. And that fact is steadily seeding fears that companies now have new, gaping security holes in their systems or, at least, will soon.

stories.title: Rivian’s startup Mind Robotics hires former Ford EV chief Doug Field
stories.description: Field also worked on Apple's secretive car project and oversaw development of the Tesla Model 3.

stories.title: Heating oil users facing fuel or food winter choice
stories.description: It comes as ministers say they will tighten up rules on heating oil and promote competition.

stories.title: Bank of America hit with $1.2bn fine for money laundering failings
stories.description: The bank inadequately flagged transactions linked to potential Chinese money laundering networks, the Treasury said.

stories.title: 210-million-year-old dinosaur discovery reveals a lost world in Africa
stories.description: A newly identified 210-million-year-old dinosaur from Zimbabwe is helping scientists uncover a surprisingly distinct prehistoric ecosystem. The discovery suggests that ancient climate differences may have separated dinosaur populations across southern Africa, leading to unique species that challenge previous assumptions about their evolution.

stories.title: AI can act exactly like a human, but we still don't think it's conscious
stories.description: A new study reveals that people draw a surprisingly sharp line between human consciousness and artificial intelligence, even when both behave identically. Researchers found that participants considered even the most responsive AI less conscious than the least responsive human.

stories.title: Leapting launches autonomous forklift for solar module transport
stories.description: The Chinese robotics manufacturer has introduced an autonomous tracked forklift capable of transporting solar module pallets weighing up to 3,000 kg. The battery-powered machine features a maximum lifting height of 3 m, a 30-degree climbing capability and a navigation system combining GNSS-RTK, laser SLAM and computer vision.

stories.title: A planet 320 light-years away confirms what scientists long suspected
stories.description: Astronomers have discovered that a scorching-hot planet 320 light-years away shares a striking chemical similarity with its host star, providing the first direct evidence for a fundamental assumption about planet formation.
